name: RapAIVideos
tagline: Turn your photos into an AI rap video — no filming
description: RapAIVideos is an AI rap video generator that turns your photos into a short rap performance clip, with no filming and no app. Upload one clear photo, or two for duo stages. Pick a trend such as Hotel Lobby, Burning Bridges, Rap Battle, or a Christmas or Halloween rap, and generate a free 5-second 480p preview made from your own photos, once per account, with no card. If you like the likeness, unlock the full 15-second 720p video with no watermark. It comes with AI-generated beat and vocals, or as a silent download for a trending sound. Full videos start at $6.99 with one-time credit packs and no subscription.
